summary: Recognizable and physically plausible full-tang utility/fighting knife; neither render shows toy-like swelling or an oversized guard. Scale is correct: 0.413 m overall, 0.125 m grip, and 0.006 m blade stock are credible, while the 1.3 m catalogue reach is correctly not used as object length. The 584-triangle construction suits Halo CE-era economy, and ATTACH_GRIP, ATTACH_BLADE, and ATTACH_TIP are usefully positioned. However, both renders wash the rubber scales, tang, fittings, blade, and bevel into similar pale grey, directly contradicting the README’s claim of decisive separation. Clean GLB inspection confirms four distinct PBR materials exist, so repair or replace the evidence-render path and verify that it respects the exported materials under neutral lighting; adjust albedo/roughness if necessary. Strengthen the blade’s modeled planar grind/spine break slightly so its wedge construction remains legible without relying entirely on shading, while preserving the sound proportions and restrained guard. Update the README to remove the unsupported successful post-export visual finding, record this failed material-read result, and state that approval remains pending until new clean-import renders visibly show dark matte grip, blackened fittings, satin blade body, and brighter ground edge.
